**Undaunted: Stalingrad Board Game Review** is an Editors' Choice review in IGN's Board genre with a score of 10. Matt Thrower wrote it, it was published Dec 6, 2022, and IGN's tagline is "A deck-building marvel."

I got there from ign.com by opening Reviews, turning on the Editors' Choice filter and picking Board under All Genres. It was the only 10 in that list. The other board game reviews shown were all 9s.

I left the browser tab open on the filtered list at ign.com/editors-choice.
